about:
MinnTech Plastics operates from Rogers, Minnesota, where it runs a modern manufacturing facility producing thermoformed trays, clamshells, and containers. The company does not publicly state its founding year or ownership details.

The company specializes in custom thermoformed packaging using APET, RPET, and CPET materials. Its in-house capabilities include CNC trim tooling, custom mold design, rapid prototyping, and production-grade aluminum tooling. The facility supports scalable runs from small sample orders to full production volumes, with multi-point quality inspection and optimized logistics.

MinnTech serves the food industry, airline catering, and specialty markets, counting leading national food brands among its customers. One reference comes from INCorporated Plastics, whose president Craig Gould describes MinnTech as a trusted manufacturer partner for PET containers.

The company emphasizes precision engineering, food safety compliance, and sustainability. It highlights tight-tolerance thermoforming, FDA-compliant materials, 100% recyclable Category #1 plastics, and transparent pricing with no hidden fees. Its CPET trays withstand temperatures from -40°F to 375°F, enabling freezer-to-oven use.
